answer: Proposed wildfire-forecast market: buyers prepay one plume report per unique beacon request; a mirror index of spent request IDs lets validators pay one signed delivery from that escrow, never per key. The farm’s cheapest move is sharing one model and self-buying jobs. Each extra profitable identity still needs a distinct outside-funded request: self-buys merely return its own deposit minus a burned fee, and loans cannot create outside demand. Validators reject replayed IDs or unfunded claims; without a new paying buyer, clones divide existing orders rather than multiply revenue.
